headline: MultiChoice Cuts DStv Top Package Price by Sh4,400 Amid Subscriber Losses
summary: MultiChoice Kenya has reduced the monthly price of its top DStv package by Sh4,400 to Sh7,300 as the pay-TV operator battles declining subscriber numbers and growing competition.
why: Subscription television providers face rising competitive pressure from streaming platforms and economic strain on household disposable incomes, forcing pricing adjustments.

impacts.name: Pay-TV & Media
impacts.why: Price cuts reflect subscriber churn and heightened competition from alternative digital platforms.
